| _October 28, 2026_ |  
  
Dear Hiring Manager,

I'm excited to apply for the Senior Full Stack Engineer role on Northwind Health's NBA platform team. The work you're describing — a control plane for authoring, governing, and publishing member actions across an enterprise — is exactly the kind of system I find most interesting to build: one where correctness, state integrity, and usability have to coexist under real operational pressure.

At Rice University, I've spent four-plus years as the primary Salesforce architect and developer for an IT department serving nearly 10,000 active users. That means designing data models, building APIs, managing CI/CD pipelines, and translating messy business workflows into clean, governed experiences — the same combination this role calls for. I've built Lightning Web Components in JavaScript, managed complex approval flows and lifecycle states across 60+ automations, and architected secure authentication patterns including guest login with temporary key rotation to avoid unnecessary license exposure. Those problems map directly to the action lifecycle, versioning, and governance challenges you're describing.

On the full-stack side, I've built React and React Native applications backed by PostgreSQL, deployed cloud functions on AWS Lambda, and integrated AWS Bedrock for LLM-powered features. I'm fluent in TypeScript and bring a strong testing and code-review discipline shaped by coursework in software architecture and algorithms at Georgia Tech (MS CS, 4.0 GPA). My Community Center Rentals project is a close analogue to the work here: a Next.js/TypeScript application with a Neon PostgreSQL backend, Upstash Redis for ephemeral state and race-safe locking, role-based access control, and an audit log on every mutating action — built precisely to be reliable under concurrent load.

I don't currently have production Kafka experience, and I'll be straightforward about that. But my background in event-driven state management, PostgreSQL schema design, and CI/CD-driven deployments gives me a solid foundation to come up to speed quickly on the streaming layer.

I'd welcome the chance to talk about how I can contribute to the NBA platform team.

---
  
Sincerely,  
  
David Hanks, P.E.

Full-stack engineer with 5+ years building production React/TypeScript applications, PostgreSQL-backed APIs, and cloud-native services on AWS. Brings deep Salesforce platform ownership, CI/CD pipelines, and enterprise workflow design to complex, user-facing operational systems.

## Professional Experience

### Full Stack Engineer — Rice University *(Feb 2021 – Present | Remote)*
- Architected and own Rice IT's Salesforce platform: ~10,000 active users, 60+ flows, 3 digital experience sites, and 4 major production applications — designing data models, APIs, and role-based access controls end-to-end.
- Developed and shipped features using Apex, Lightning Web Components (JavaScript), and SOQL; translated complex HR and IT workflows into governed, configurable user experiences.
- Built and maintained CI/CD Bitbucket pipelines to test and deploy version-controlled software to Salesforce, enforcing code-review gates before production releases.
- Architected a secure guest-login pattern using temporary rotating keys to avoid single-use community licenses — an identity and access design analogous to OAuth token flows.
- Developed an automated, containerized daily backup of custom objects; configured OAuth-authenticated connected apps for backup, VCS pipeline, and data-integration services.
- Maintained and patched cloud APIs (Python/Flask), WAF, CDNs, and DNS; collaborated with Oracle/Banner teams to keep employee and student data synchronized across systems.

## Education

**Georgia Institute of Technology** — M.S. Computer Science | GPA: 4.0 | Dec 2023  
**University of Louisiana at Lafayette** — B.S. Mechanical Engineering | GPA: 3.4 | 2002

## Personal Projects

### Community Center Rentals
A two-app Next.js (App Router) + TypeScript system for online facility reservations. Features a public storefront (browse, check availability, pay via PayPal) and an authenticated admin app with server-side RBAC (scheduler vs. admin roles), an audit log on every mutating request, and a race-safe booking layer — Neon PostgreSQL advisory locks plus a transaction-level re-check ensure no double-booking under concurrent load. Ephemeral state (pending orders, locks, webhook dedup) lives in Upstash Redis with short TTLs. Both apps deploy to GCP Cloud Run (scale-to-zero) with secrets in Secret Manager.
**Technologies:** Next.js, TypeScript, Neon PostgreSQL, Upstash Redis, Firebase Auth, PayPal, GCP Cloud Run, Secret Manager

*(No public URL on file for this project — omitted per instructions)*

### Climbing Pins
React Native mobile app for discovering and sharing rock climbing routes on an interactive map. Global state is driven by Cloud Firestore `onSnapshot` listeners streaming live data into a React Context store. Features dual Firebase backend fan-out (Firestore + Realtime Database) through a coordination middleware layer, geohash-based proximity queries, Firebase Auth with custom claims for admin/moderator RBAC, and Android runtime permissions for camera, media, and location. Released to the Google Play Store. [read more...](https://youtube.com/playlist?list=PL8KBlR63foXz7Sw3mzJc6e9Dy5FmX8Jcy&si=qDIWACxDcfe-iyBf)
